Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Girish Kathpalia
 Order

1. Petitioners seek quashing of FIR No. 94/2017 of Police Station Shakarpur for offence under Sections 376/109/354/328/506/34 IPC on the ground that the complainant de facto (respondent no. 2) has compromised the disputes with the petitioners.
2. Since none appears for petitioners and respondent no. 2, matter has to be adjourned.
On the next date, learned counsel for petitioner shall address as to why the inherent powers be invoked to quash such heinous offence as reflected in FIR.
It is made clear that there is no stay of trial court proceedings.
